features.statement: Heading levels are used out of order, with h3 card titles appearing before the first h2 in the outline.
Hero is a single flat image with text baked in: dark panel on one side, people photo on the other.
A single sans-serif font family is used across all page elements.
Section headings are bold, mid-large (about 35px) and colored dark navy rather than black.
Body text uses a near-black tinted navy instead of pure black.
Palette is built on a family of blues: deep navy, saturated brand blue, sky blue and pale blue tint.
Section backgrounds alternate between white and a pale blue tint to separate content bands.
Search form sits on a dark strip below the hero with a text input, select and pill button.
Corners are square by default, with moderate 8–15px rounding on cards and images and pill-shaped buttons.
Cards are lifted with soft drop shadows instead of borders; no gradients, blur, animations or transforms.
Content is arranged in three-column card grids with top photo, bold navy title and gray body text.
Card images beside visible headings carry empty alt text.
Primary call-to-action buttons are filled brand-blue pills.
Two-column split sections pair intro text with a ruled list of rows, each ending in a thin arrow.
Section titles use playful wordplay on the brand slogan with short, warm, people-focused phrasing.
Profile cards sit in a four-column grid of uniform square photos, with an incomplete last row left empty.
Person cards stack a bold name, job title and smaller gray location line.
Photography is candid, people-centric workplace imagery, cropped to uniform sizes within each group.
Carousels present profiles and testimonials, with a photo beside a timeline or large typographic-quote text and attribution.
Some sections are minimal, such as a centered heading with a single pill button.
Social image row shows square rounded thumbnails, upscaled beyond natural size so they look soft.
Footer is a minimal full-width dark navy band with centered white heading and social icons.
Header is minimal: only a logo at the far left edge, with no navigation menu.
Content sits in a centered container about 1080px wide with wide side margins on a long page.
Markup uses sparse, non-utility class names and manual br line breaks in copy.
Page has minimal metadata, with no structured data and only basic meta tags.
